adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chain causes `push` to be skipped, so any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently not added. This matches the finding: team members' destination calendars can be dropped when the organizer/event type has no destination calendar.
